module_summary: 16-bit word-grabber using phase toggle to capture high byte on odd strobe pulses.

anchors.name: odd_q
anchors.why: Phase toggle; toggles on every strobe, gates grab_w to odd cycles.

anchors.name: hi_byte
anchors.why: Holds first byte of 16-bit word; captured on odd strobe.

anchors.name: stb
anchors.why: Strobe input; gates byte capture and phase toggle.

anchors.name: bus_i
anchors.why: 8-bit input data; captured into hi_byte on grab_w.

anchors.name: grab_w
anchors.why: Capture enable; asserted on odd strobe cycles.

groups.name: Phase Control
groups.description: Phase toggle and strobe gating for byte capture selection.

groups.name: Data Capture
groups.description: Input bus and high-byte holding register.
